searchText: Easiest way to answer this would be to write a tiny solidity program and compile it then look at the bytecode. Solidity questions are also generally better asked over at the solidity forums. The people here don't really work with solidity much. Good thinking I'll do that now. Ok sounds good wasn't sure if op code things are good here or not as well. Is there a good place for evm ops for future questions? My guess is that it just gets masked. I believe that is how `address` is handled. If you have a question about the EVM opcodes themselves, here is reasonable. However, how solidity generates them is out of scope for this server generally speaking. Got it, sounds good thank you for the clarification
